component.name: steM.
component.summary: Yapay Zekâ Destekli Ses Ayrıştırma Stüdyosu

description.p: steM. is a professional, modern AI audio separation studio for Linux powered by Demucs. It separates songs into high-fidelity isolated stems (vocals, drums, bass, instrumental, and other) through an elegant GTK4 and Libadwaita interface.

ul.li: AI-powered 4-stem and 2-stem separation with Demucs v4
Low-latency multi-track synchronized stem playback studio
Independent faders, mute, and solo controls per stem
Interactive audio waveform visualizer and scrubber
Hardware optimization for NVIDIA GPUs with VRAM safeguards

description.p: Added Turkish and English bilingual language support with runtime switching.
Initial release of steM. — AI Audio Separation Studio.
